description:
**Job Title:** Finance Manager – Modular Showroom & Site Accounts

**Location:** RS Puram - Coimbatore

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Working Hours:** Showroom Retail Timings

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a hands-on, resilient **Finance Manager** to manage end-to-end showroom accounting, project billing, vendor settlements, and on-ground payment collections for our modular kitchen and interior showroom. Beyond desk accounting, this role requires frequent field travel to project sites, warehouses, and factories for physical stock audits, vendor negotiations, and direct payment follow-ups.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Milestone Billing & Collections:** Raise client invoices based on project stages (booking, production, dispatch, handover) and follow up on pending payments before material dispatch.
* **Project Costing:** Check customer quotations and BOQs against material, hardware, and factory costs to protect project profit margins.
* **Vendor & Factory Payments:** Verify and reconcile bills from factories, hardware suppliers, and installation carpenters before releasing payments.
* **Daily Showroom Accounts:** Manage daily showroom cash, card/UPI settlements, bank reconciliations, and petty cash in Tally.
* **Stock & Dispatch Compliance:** Track showroom display stock, conduct warehouse inventory checks, and generate e-way bills for material dispatches.
* **GST & Tax Filing:** Handle monthly GST returns, TDS deductions, and coordinate with auditors for annual filings.
* **Monthly Reports:** Prepare simple monthly Profit & Loss (P&L) statements, sales trackers, and cash flow updates for management.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Minimum 3–5 years in finance and accounting, ideally within a **modular furniture showroom, interior turnkey company, construction, or building materials business**.
* **Mobility & Availability:** Must own a **valid two-wheeler/four-wheeler driving license** and be willing to travel locally on short notice for bank work, site verification, warehouse audits, and client/vendor meetings.
* **Working Schedule:** Comfortable working standard retail showroom hours and staying late during month-end closings or urgent material dispatches.
* **Technical Skills:** Strong command of **Tally Prime**, **MS Excel**, GST, and e-way bill portals.
* **Core Attributes:** Strong negotiation skills, ability to handle high-pressure collection follow-ups, and comfort working closely with site supervisors, logistics teams, and factory vendors.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

title: Analyst, Cluster Head- Current Account, Consumer Banking Group
description:
Key Responsibilities

* Cluster Business Ownership
* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.
* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.
* Translate cluster targets into branch-, team- and individual-level productivity plans.
* Own the current-account business plan, sales funnel, conversion pipeline and weekly performance rhythm.
* Improve portfolio quality by prioritising transaction-active, balance-building and cross-sell-ready relationships over dormant or low-value acquisition.

* Sales Leadership and Channel Execution
* Lead, coach and motivate a field-sales organisation to consistently deliver acquisition and value-build targets.
* Establish a disciplined sales cadence covering joint calls, market visits, lead reviews, branch huddles, pipeline reviews and conversion tracking.
* Ensure each relationship manager follows a profile-based sales approach rather than a generic product pitch.
* Develop market intelligence on competitor propositions, local business clusters, referral sources and emerging commercial hubs.
* Build productive referral ecosystems with Chartered Accountants, trade associations, market intermediaries, merchant networks, developers, institutional administrators and existing clients.

* Current-Account Activation and Value Build-Up
* Ensure newly acquired accounts become transaction-active within defined activation timelines.
* Drive operating balances, inward credits, collections, payment activity and digital banking adoption.
* Track early-warning indicators including low funding, non-activation, declining balances, low transaction velocity and potential attrition.
* Build strategies to migrate primary transaction flows—collections, vendor payments, payroll, taxes and operating cash—to the bank.
* Improve account quality by monitoring average balance, debit transactions, credit transactions and account profitability.

* Solution-Led Cross-Sell
* Use the current account as the primary operating hub for business clients and identify the appropriate product solution based on the customer’s business model.
* Drive adoption of corporate internet banking and mobile approvals; cash management and bulk payment solutions; POS, Android POS, QR and Soundbox; sweep-in / sweep-out or FFD structures; debit cards; collections and transaction banking solutions; and promoter, family, wealth and premium savings propositions.
* Partner with product teams to convert business pain points into integrated propositions—for example, POS for collections, Internet Banking for payment controls, FFD for temporary balances and Aspire/premium banking for promoter wallet deepening.

* Customer Relationship and Service Governance
* Build senior-level relationships with anchor clients and participate in strategic joint calls for high-value prospects.
* Ensure timely resolution of onboarding, account-opening, transaction, service and digital-banking issues.
* Work with branches and operations teams to reduce turnaround time, improve onboarding quality and strengthen client experience.
* Review top customers and at-risk accounts regularly to protect balances, transactions and wallet share.
* Drive customer retention through proactive engagement, problem solving and relevant product deepening.

* Risk, Compliance and Portfolio Quality
* Ensure all sourcing, onboarding and account activation follows internal policies and applicable KYC, AML, fraud-risk and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain high standards of customer due diligence, documentation quality, source-of-funds understanding and business-profile validation.
* Monitor exceptions, unusual transaction behaviour, documentation gaps and operational risks; escalate promptly where needed.
* Build a culture of right-first-time acquisition, with no compromise on compliance for target achievement.

* People Leadership
* Recruit, develop, retain and performance-manage a high-quality current-account sales team.
* Set clear scorecards covering acquisition, activation, AQB/AMB, transaction activity, fee income, cross-sell, productivity, service quality and compliance.
* Conduct structured coaching through joint market visits, call observations, weekly reviews and capability-building sessions.
